crossRefs.note: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the…
“ ‘ “Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and…
They were arrogant, and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.
Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

people.name: Lot
people.line: Abraham's nephew; rescued from Sodom's destruction

translations.web: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
translations.bsb: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
translations.kjv: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
translations.asv: Likewise even as it came to pass in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;
